summary: Kennedy-Wilson Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary issued $1.8 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes ($1.1B 7.000% notes due 2031 and $700M 7.250% notes due 2033) in a Rule 144A/Regulation S offering. No terms such as price per share or premium apply as this is a debt issuance, not an equity special situation. Proceeds are earmarked to redeem existing notes and for general corporate purposes, pending a previously announced merger. No board recommendation or advisor is noted. This is a routine debt financing/refinancing filing; no special situation classification is warranted.
